name: fastapi_constraints
description: Exercises the constraint extractor (auth via Depends, rate limit via decorator), the part_of detector (document nested under workspace), the prerequisite detector (login before protected endpoints), and concept-noise filtering. Docstrings contain ordinary prose sentences so that a fragment-slicing concept extractor produces detectable garbage.
forbidden_concepts: workspaces are shared containers that several
notes: The README names POST /auth/login and GET /workspaces explicitly and describes their behavior, so those two count as documented. It describes the workspace and document *concepts* but never documents the three remaining endpoints — describing an entity is not documenting the operations on it, and conflating the two is the single most likely way for this tool to overstate coverage. GET /workspaces is declared as @workspace_router.get("") on a router with prefix="/workspaces", so the resolved path has no trailing slash.
